text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem comes from. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, to watch how the program runs. A systematic approach is also helpful: check one part at a time instead of guessing. Another useful method is logging. By adding print statements or log messages, you can see what values your variables have and where things go wrong. With patience and good strategies, you can solve most bugs quickly.
